sentences.text: CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS No.65267 of 2022  Arising Out of PS. Case No.-38 Year-2022 Thana- KASMA District- Au

ALAKH KUMAR SINGH S/O BABAN SINGH Resident of village- Nuwan,
 Post- Kabilaspur, Nuawan, District- Kaimur at Bhabhua.

... 
 Versus  The State Of Bihar
... ... Opposite Party

= = = =
 Appearance :

For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Nikhil Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Binod Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 5 20-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 279, 295A, 378, 414, 417, 420, 428, 429, 465 and 129(B) of the Indian Penal Code, Section 11 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animal and Section 3, 4, 4(B) of the Bihar Preservation and Improvement Act pending in the learned court below.
As per the prosecution case, petitioner is said to have involved in the smuggling and theft of cattle.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He further submits that petitioner is neither the owner of the truck-container from which the recovery has been made nor Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.65267 of 2022(5) dt.20-06-2023 associated with the persons from whose possession recovery has been made.
He submits that there is no specific overt act against the petitioner.
He further submits that there is no evidence came out against the petitioner in the case diary.
He submits that petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of the bail application.
Learned APP for the State opposes for prayer for bail.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, named above, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the Alakh Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49790741/
1
